sn56.11:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
sn56.11:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi
sn56.11:2.1: dveme bhikkhave antā pabbajitena na sevitabbā.
sn56.11:2.3: yo cāyaṃ kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasañhito yo cāyaṃ attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasañhito.
sn56.11:2.4: etete bhikkhave ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.11:3.1: katamā ca sā bhikkhave majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.11:3.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sn56.11:3.4: ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn56.11:4.1: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.11:4.2: jātipi dukkhā jarāpi dukkhā byādhīpi dukkhā maraṇampi dukkhaṃ appiyehi sampayogo dukkho piyehi vippayogo dukkho yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
sn56.11:4.3: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.11:4.4: yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatrābhinandinī. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn56.11:4.6: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.11:4.7: yo tassā yeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.
sn56.11:4.8: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.11:5.1: idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:5.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyanti me bhikkhave pubbe …pe…
sn56.11:5.3: pariññātanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:6.1: idaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:6.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ pahātabbanti me bhikkhave pubbe …pe…
sn56.11:6.3: pahīnanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:7.1: idaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:7.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:7.3: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ sacchikatanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:8.1: idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:8.2: taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabbanti me bhikkhave …pe…
sn56.11:8.3: bhāvitanti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn56.11:9.1: yāvakīvañca me bhikkhave imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evantiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn56.11:10.1: yato ca kho me bhikkhave imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evantiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ ahosi athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn56.11:10.3: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
sn56.11:10.5: attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
sn56.11:11.1: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne āyasmato koṇḍaññassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
sn56.11:12.1: pavattite ca bhagavatā dhammacakke bhummā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ
sn56.11:12.2: etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
sn56.11:12.3: bhummānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā cātummahārājikā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ
sn56.11:12.4: etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
sn56.11:12.5: cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā tāvatiṃsā devā.
sn56.11:12.11: etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
sn56.11:13.1: itiha tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi.
sn56.11:13.2: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi. appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvanti.
sn56.11:14.2: aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño aññāsi vata bho koṇḍaññoti.
sn56.11:14.3: iti hidaṃ āyasmato koṇḍaññassa aññākoṇḍaññotveva nāmaṃ ahosīti.
